accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_policy: MANDATORY: All interactive elements, status badges, submit buttons, modals, table cells, and metrics must have descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components matching existing project setup.
Implement full Portuguese (pt-BR) terminology tailored for Miliano Business Solutions (@recompensalogistica).
Ensure crisp layout with dark theme as primary visual style, with smooth toggle to light theme.
Prioritize smooth user flows with reactive state (search, filter, pagination, modal forms, status updates, toasts via Sonner).

Include mock data pre-populated with realistic Brazilian restaurants (e.g., 'Brito Burguer', 'Pizzaria Bella Napoli', 'Sabor Mineiro') and couriers (e.g., 'Carlos Eduardo', 'Matheus Oliveira', 'Fernanda Lima').
Contracts & Payments must clearly support manual payment tracking (Pendente, Pago, Atrasado), value calculations, and manual proof settlement simulator.
Maintain strict data-testid attributes across all components for automated testing compliance.
Never leave empty state or broken UI elements; provide rich mock interactions for all buttons and modals.

design_anti_patterns: No generic un-tinted pure black background (#000000)
No missing focus/hover states on buttons
No transparent dropdown/modal backgrounds without blur/solid fill
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Add smooth hover transitions, pulse indicators on live delivery status, and Sonner toast notifications on create/update actions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_philosophy: Use generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6 inside cards) to avoid visual collision.
